Thanks Mina — nice to meet you on the call earlier. A couple quick asks so my procurement lead can start modeling: 

1) Can you send a simple per-1M token benchmark you use for hosted vs dedicated vs private deployments? We'd like a side-by-side that shows the typical list price and a committed (volume) target price.
2) We plan to pilot with ~100M tokens/month initially, with a growth plan to ~1B tokens over 12 months. For budgeting purposes, what target $/1M token range should we expect at the 100M and 1B tiers?
3) Any constraints on PII/PHI we should know for private deployments (we'll loop in security separately).

I attached a small traffic sample we discussed. Procurement wants to understand the unit economics so they can compare to our current host.

Appreciate a brief breakdown — a spreadsheet or a short note will do.

Best,

Eliot — great speaking with you. Putting the short benchmarking below so procurement has something concrete to start with. Attaching our one-pager and the sample price sheet.

Attachment: RB-Inference-pricing-sheet-1M-slides.pdf (pdf stub)

Summary (hosted vs dedicated vs private) — per 1M tokens, representative pricing bands (list vs committed/volume):

- OpenAI (public reference for comparison): ~ $28 — $35 / 1M (depends on model family; higher for instruction-tuned large models)
- Anthropic (reference): ~ $25 — $33 / 1M
- Typical unmanaged open-host (self-host / cloud VM + operator): ~$8 — $20 / 1M (wide range depending on quantization and infra ops)

Redwood reference bands (what we typically quote):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go list): $24 — $30 / 1M
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool, committed usage): $10 — $16 / 1M for 100M+ tokens/month depending on model family and quantization; better on multi-quarter commitments
- Private (VPC / on-prem managed): $8 — $14 / 1M at larger commits (250M+ tokens/month) — higher integration/setup fees may apply separately

Notes / assumptions:
- These numbers are per-1M tokens normalized for generation-style workloads (mix of prompts + outputs). Exact rates vary by sequence length profile and KV cache reuse.
- The "open-host" band shows typical raw infra + operator cost; it does not include engineering overhead or production SLAs. Redwood's dedicated/private numbers include managed SLAs and automatic fallbacks.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Confirm the two monthly buckets you expect for the pilot (you mentioned ~100M/month). If you can posture a 3-6 month committed minimum, we can firm the dedicated rate.
2) We'll run a simple token-cost model using your attached traffic sample to estimate expected monthly spend in each tier — Ben will own that and share a one-sheet.
3) Security deep-dive: Laura will coordinate the compliance checklist and the private deployment options if PHI/PII is in scope.

If helpful I can show a hypothetical cost table for 100M, 300M, 1B monthly volumes — say yes and I will send it by EOD.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

All — quick internal note and proposal for the next touch. Mina, I'm happy to draft the 100M / 300M / 1B cost table. Preliminary thinking to keep margin and flexibility:

- Pilot (100M/mo): committed price target $10 — $12 / 1M for dedicated (we can go lower if they sign 6-12 month commit + SLA)
- Scale (300M — 1B): $7 — $10 / 1M on private/dedicated profiles, contingent on predictable perf profile and 3rd-party model licensing where applicable
- If HealthBridge wants hosted (no commit), we'll present the list rates ($24-$30 / 1M) but offer a time-limited pilot credit structure to bridge the economics.

Action: I'll prepare the table and include the margin implications and the recommended minimum committed spend threshold (we should ask for $X/month minimum; will calculate after we map their traffic).
